    ...(target.score ? { score: target.score } : {}),
    ...(target.shootout ? { shootout: target.shootout } : {}),
  }
  // The open counts as a read in flight from now until its own re-reads are armed: the read already in flight (whose
  // answer, its binding replaced, writes nothing) ending meanwhile fires no kept re-read beside the open's own.
  paneReads += 1
  try {
    // The pane opens at once, inside the command's hook (an open is the person's only within about 15 s of the
    // command, measured), showing the band's line and the view's footer until the CLI's rows land.
    const view = reading.answered ? reading.view : null
    const attribution = view === null ? null : relayed(view.attribution)
    const disclaimer = view === null ? null : relayed(view.disclaimer)
    const provisional: NonNullable<ClaudinhoPane> = {
      gen,
      slug: b.slug,
      id: b.id,
      kind: 'rows',
      lines: view === null ? [] : [cut(view.line, PANE_LINE_CHARS)],
      ...(attribution !== null ? { attribution: cut(attribution, PANE_FOOTER_CHARS) } : {}),
      ...(disclaimer !== null ? { disclaimer: cut(disclaimer, PANE_FOOTER_CHARS) } : {}),
      refreshFailed: false,
      status: null,
      kickoff: null,
      final: false,
    }
    let shown = false
    await update($, pane, (cur) => {
      shown = bound === b
      return shown ? provisional : cur
    })
    if (!shown || bound !== b) return false
    try {
      await $.ui.open({ id: PANE_ID, title: PANE_TITLE })
    } catch {
      // The open was refused: nothing shows it, so nothing reads it.
      if (bound === b) {
        bound = null
        stopPaneTimers()
      }
      return false
    }
    // Then its turn and its read; an open a later open superseded while it waited makes no run.
    const answer = await inTurn(async () => (bound === b ? runMatch($, b, env) : null))
    if (answer === null || bound !== b) return false
    const v: NonNullable<ClaudinhoPane> = { gen, slug: b.slug, id: b.id, refreshFailed: false, ...answer }
    let wrote = false
    await update($, pane, (cur) => {
      wrote = bound === b
      return wrote ? v : cur
    })
    if (!wrote || bound !== b) return false
    b.final = v.final
    await armPane($, b, v)
    // The short reply leaves the footer to the pane: only when the pane holds both sentences.
    return v.kind === 'rows' && typeof v.attribution === 'string' && typeof v.disclaimer === 'string'
  } finally {
    paneReadEnded($)
  }
}

/** The pane closed (by the person, or any close): a new generation, no value, no binding, no timers. */
async function closePane($: EngineInterface): Promise<void> {
  bound = null
  observed = null
  rereadPending = false
  stopPaneTimers()
  await update($, paneGen, (g) => (typeof g === 'number' && Number.isFinite(g) ? g : 0) + 1)
  await update($, pane, () => null)
}

/**
 * One run of the CLI, bounded; at most one in flight; paced by the last line unless `force`. A forced run asked while
 * one is in flight is kept (once) and made as soon as that run ends. No rejection escapes: a timer's callback calls it.
 */
function tick($: EngineInterface, option: ToastsOption, force = false): Promise<void> {
  if (busy) {
    if (force) forcedPending = true
    return Promise.resolve()
  }
  busy = true
  return run($, option, force)
    .catch(() => {
      // A run that failed in the engine's calls: nothing more to do until the next fire.
    })
    .finally(() => {
      busy = false
      if (forcedPending) {
        forcedPending = false
        void tick($, option, true)
      }
    })
}

async function run($: EngineInterface, option: ToastsOption, force: boolean): Promise<void> {
  // (1) No surface that draws the band (none yet, the last one detached, or the roster cannot be read): no process,
  // the band cleared, so a band surface attaching again never shows an old line, and the pace reset, so the next run
  // the roster allows is not held by an idle gap; the baseline and the context are left.
  if (!(await mayRun($))) {
    await clear($)
    return
  }
  // (2) On a non-idle line the timer is the only pace; the age check is the idle gap's alone.
  const now = await $.clock.now()
  const last = await read($, pace)
  if (!force && last.idle && now - last.ranAt < IDLE_MS) return
  // (3) The PATH, bounded, and the language the band's run is always handed.
  const env = await runEnv($)
  const lang = await runLang($)
  // (4) The roster again, the last await before the spawn: the surface may have left while the PATH was looked up.
  if (!(await mayRun($))) {
    await clear($)
    return
  }
  // (5) The spawn.
  const c = clears
  let result: RunResult | undefined
  try {
    result = await $.process.run(['claudinho', 'ambient', '--json', '--columns', String(columns), ...langArgs(lang)], {
      timeoutMs: RUN_TIMEOUT_MS,
      stdin: '',
      ...(env ? { env } : {}),
    })
  } catch {
    // No binary, a timeout, a refused spawn: a failed run.
  }
  const reading = readAnswer(result)
  markLocalizes(reading)
  if (!reading.answered) {
    // A failed run: nothing shown, the baseline and the context left, the next run at the next fire.
    if (clears === c) await update($, pace, () => ({ ranAt: now, idle: false }))
    await update($, band, (cur) => (clears === c ? null : cur))
    return
  }
  // The reading's facts (`readAnswer`): an object that is no view is hidden, never current (the context cleared, the
  // baseline kept, nothing toasted); an idle answer is read slowly.
  const { view, firstRun, isView, idle, hidden } = reading
  if (clears === c) await update($, pace, () => ({ ranAt: now, idle }))
  const parts = hidden ? null : linePartsOf(view)
  await update($, band, (cur) =>
    clears === c ? (hidden ? null : { text: view.line, ...(parts !== null ? { parts } : {}) }) : cur,
  )

  // The celebration's competition, first: a view (current or not) or the first-run object naming another competition
  // than the record's, or none (the first run's is ''), drops it and stops the redraws. The fallback object names no
  // competition and leaves it (the 60 s bound ends it); a failed run returned above.
  if (isView || firstRun) {
    const rec = await read($, celebration)
    if (rec !== null && slugOf(view) !== rec.slug) {
      stopTicker()
      await update($, celebration, (cur) => (cur !== null && cur.at === rec.at ? null : cur))
    }
  }

  // The two shapes that are no view are no current view either: each clears the context and keeps the baseline.
  if (isView && view.current === true) {
    const prev = await read($, baseline)
    const moments = momentsFor(view, prev, option)
    for (const m of moments) for (const text of m.texts) $.ui.toast(text)
    const played = celebrateOn ? moments.filter((m) => m.plays.length > 0) : []
    // What this view says of the celebration's match (its competition was asked above): its score differing from the
    // one the goal was decided on drops it (playing or waiting). The null stops the redraws too; a goal this run
    // decided is written after.
    const rec = await read($, celebration)
    if (rec !== null && (differsFromRecord(view, rec) || (rec.kind === 'fulltime' && !fullTimeStands(view, rec)))) {
      stopTicker()
      await update($, celebration, (cur) => (cur !== null && cur.at === rec.at ? null : cur))
    } else if (rec !== null && !fullTimeStands(view, rec)) {
      // A full-time play queued behind a goal, no longer standing: the queue alone is dropped; the goal play stays
      // under its own rules (a stretch on screen past the goal ends there).
      await update($, celebration, (cur) => {
        if (cur === null || cur.at !== rec.at) return cur
        const { queue: _dropped, ...kept } = cur
        return kept
      })
    }
    await update($, baseline, () => baselineOf(view))
    // The celebration of the run's LAST match with a play, decided now: its first play, and full time's queued behind
    // a goal from the same read. The one clear-generation check is inside the write, the latest point: a clear since
    // the spawn (also while the clock is read) wins, and the run writes nothing.
    const goal = played[played.length - 1]
    const [first, ...queue] = goal?.plays ?? []
    if (goal !== undefined && first !== undefined) {
      const at = await $.clock.now()
      let wrote = false
      await update($, celebration, (cur) => {
        wrote = clears === c
        return wrote
          ? {
              ...first,
              at,
              slug: slugOf(view),
              id: goal.id,
              ...(goal.score ? { score: goal.score } : {}),
              ...(goal.shootout ? { shootout: goal.shootout } : {}),
              ...(queue.length > 0 ? { queue: queue.slice(0, 1) } : {}),
            }
          : cur
      })
      if (wrote) {
        playingAt = at
        playedMs = 0
        playFrom = holdTurn ? null : at
        lastPlayedAt = at
        if (holdTurn) stopTicker()
        else startTicker($)
      }
    }
    await update($, lastContext, () => ({
      context: typeof view.context === 'string' && view.context !== '' ? view.context : null,
      staleAfter: typeof view.staleAfter === 'string' ? view.staleAfter : null,
      ranAt: now,
    }))
    // The match pane's news: this current view against the band's previous observation of the bound match (its
    // competition only). The re-read runs on its own, never holding the band's run.
    if (paneNews(view)) reread($)
  } else {
    // A view that is not current, of any competition, says nothing about play: the context clears and the baseline
    // stays. Only a current view replaces it (a current view of another competition compares nothing and replaces
    // it; a disappearance rebases), so a change across the gap is said at the next current view, late, never lost
    // while the match stays in the list.
    await update($, lastContext, () => null)
  }
}

/**
 * Starts the pace once per module load: the first run right after the hook resolves (never inside it), then every 15
 * seconds. Returns whether it started it now.
 */
function ensurePace($: EngineInterface, option: ToastsOption): boolean {
  if (paced) return false
  paced = true
  $.clock.after(0, () => {
    void tick($, option, true)
  })
  $.clock.every(LIVE_MS, () => {
    void tick($, option)
  })
  return true
}

export const register: Register = (on, options) => {
  const option: ToastsOption = TOASTS_OPTIONS.includes(options.toasts as ToastsOption)
    ? (options.toasts as ToastsOption)
    : 'pinned'
  // Only the string `off` turns the celebration off.
  celebrateOn = options.celebrate !== 'off'
  // Only the string `off` turns the prompt context off.
  contextOn = options.context !== 'off'
  // One of the four codes is that language; anything else (`auto`, unset, unknown) is auto.
  languageOption = isLang(options.language) ? options.language : 'auto'

  on('session.start', async ($, e, next) => {
    // `/claudinho` in every session, headless included: the person types it. A registration refused leaves the start
    // as it was.
    try {
      await $.command.register({ name: 'claudinho', description: COMMAND_DESCRIPTION })
    } catch {
      // No command this session; the band goes on.
    }
    // The start's own surface is not the question (the desktop app's is null, as `-p`'s): the roster is. A read that
    // rejects is unknown: the pace starts, and each run asks again.
    let start: boolean
    try {
      start = await drawable($)
    } catch {
      start = true
    }
    if (start) ensurePace($, option)
    return next(e)
  })

  on('session.attach', ($, e, next) => {
    // A band surface attached: the pace if it is not running, and a run at once either way.
    if (drawsBand(e.surface) && !ensurePace($, option)) {
      $.clock.after(0, () => {
        void tick($, option, true)
      })
    }
    return next(e)
  })

  on('session.detach', async ($, e, next) => {
    // The session is ending: nothing to do.
    if (e.reason === 'end') return next(e)
    // The client is already out of the roster here. The last band surface gone: the band cleared at once, so a quick
    // re-attach never shows an old line. No run and no timer started.
    const r = await next(e)
    if (!(await mayRun($))) await clear($)
    return r
  })

  on('turn.start', (_$, e, next) => {
    // A main-loop turn holds the celebration: paused at its last frame drawn, no redraws asked.
    holdTurn = true
    pausePlayback(Math.max(lastPlayedAt, playFrom ?? 0))
    stopTicker()
    return next(e)
  })

  on('turn.complete', ($, e, next) => {
    // Only the main loop's turn ends the hold (a subagent's turn ends with its `agentId`); the ticker again after the
    // hook returns, when there is still something to play.
    if (e.agentId === undefined) {
      holdTurn = false
      $.clock.after(0, () => {
        void resumeTicker($).catch(() => {
          // The engine's calls failed: no redraws are asked until the next goal or the next turn's end.
        })
      })
    }
    return next(e)
  })

  on('ui.render', { component: 'AbovePrompt' }, async ($, e, next) => {
    const width = e.props.bodyColumns
    if (typeof width === 'number' && Number.isInteger(width) && width > 0) columns = width
    const shown = await read($, band)
    const rec = celebrateOn ? await read($, celebration) : null
    const now = rec === null ? 0 : await $.clock.now()
    // (1) A survey holds the band, or there is no room: nothing of ours, as before; the celebration paused, no redraws.
    if (e.props.hasSurvey || e.props.maxRows < 1) {
      pausePlayback(now)
      stopTicker()
      return next(e)
    }
    const { Box, Text } = $.ui.resolve(e)
    // The CLI fitted the line to the width asked, its `+N` suffix reserved; the engine's cut is the backstop. Its
    // `lineParts`, kept only when they join to the line, draw each `strong` part bold. A band beneath ours in the hook
    // chain (a plugin registered after ours, or the engine's own) stays, under our line.
    const lineRow =
      shown === null ? null : Array.isArray(shown.parts) ? (
        <Text wrap="truncate-end">
          {shown.parts.map((p, i) =>
            p.style === 'strong' ? (
              <Text key={`part-${i}`} bold>
                {p.text}
              </Text>
            ) : (
              <Text key={`part-${i}`}>{p.text}</Text>
            ),
          )}
        </Text>
      ) : (
        <Text wrap="truncate-end">{shown.text}</Text>
      )
    const withLine = async (above: RenderChildren[]) =>
      above.length === 0 && shown === null ? next(e) : (
        <Box flexDirection="column">
          {above}
          {lineRow}
          {await next(e)}
        </Box>
      )
    // (2) Nothing to play (no record, spent, or older than 60 s and not on screen): the band as before.
    if (rec === null || !playable(rec, now)) {
      if (rec !== null) stopTicker()
      return withLine([])
    }
    // (3) Held (a main-loop turn, or the drawn isWorking) or no room for a row: our line alone; the celebration paused,
    // no redraws.
    const rows = Math.min(3, e.props.maxRows - 2)
    const heldNow = holdTurn || e.props.isWorking === true
    if (heldNow || rows <= 0) {
      pausePlayback(now)
      stopTicker()
      return withLine([])
    }
    // (4) Playing: the play on screen and its frame from the time on screen, then our line (never an old one brought
    // back), then the band beneath.
    if (playFrom === null) playFrom = now
    lastPlayedAt = now
    // A pause no event ends (a survey, no room, a hold seen only in the drawn `isWorking`) stopped the redraws: the
    // playing draw starts them again.
    if (!ticker) startTicker($)
    let t = playedAt(now)
    let play: ClaudinhoPlay = rec
    for (const p of playsOf(rec)) {
      play = p
      if (t < playLength(p)) break
      t -= playLength(p)
    }
    const step = Math.floor(t / FRAME_MS)
    const frame = Math.min(FRAMES - 1, step)
    if (play.kind === 'goal' || play.kind === 'fulltime') {
      // The goal moments (a record that carries `names`): the mascot in three rows, else the words alone.
      // The goal word the play was built with, whole on every frame (no character reveal).
      const goalWord =
        play.kind === 'goal' ? (
          <Text key="goal-word" bold color={GOAL_COLOR}>
            {play.word}
          </Text>
        ) : null
      let middle: RenderChildren
      let top: string
      let bottom: string
      if (play.kind === 'goal') {
        if (rows === 1) {
          return withLine([
            <Text key="row-0" wrap="truncate-end">
              {goalWord}
              {` ${words(play.team, play.minute)}`}
            </Text>,
          ])
        }
        middle = (
          <Text key="row-1" wrap="truncate-end">
            {goalWord}
            {` ${play.team}`}
          </Text>
        )
        if (rows === 2) {
          return withLine(
            play.detail === ''
              ? [middle]
              : [
                  middle,
                  <Text key="row-2" wrap="truncate-end">
                    {play.detail}
                  </Text>,
                ],
          )
        }
        top = ballRow(frame, Math.max(0, columns - MASCOT_COLUMNS - MASCOT_GAP))
        bottom = play.detail === '' ? ' ' : play.detail
      } else {
        middle = (
          <Text key="row-1" wrap="truncate-end">
            {`${play.heading} · ${play.result}`}
          </Text>
        )
        if (rows < 3) return withLine([middle])
        top = ' '
        bottom = ' '
      }
      return withLine([
        <Box key="mascot">
          <Box flexDirection="column">
            <Text color={MASCOT_COLOR}>{MASCOT_HEAD}</Text>
            <Text color={MASCOT_COLOR}>{MASCOT_BODY}</Text>
            <Text color={MASCOT_COLOR}>{MASCOT_LEGS[step % 2]}</Text>
          </Box>
          <Box flexDirection="column" paddingLeft={MASCOT_GAP}>
            <Text wrap="truncate-end">{top}</Text>
            {middle}
            <Text wrap="truncate-end">{bottom}</Text>
          </Box>
        </Box>,
      ])
    }
    // A record whose match carries no `names` (CLI 0.11.2): today's banner frames.
    const text = play.kind === 'banner' ? play.text : ''
    return withLine(
      celebrationRows(frame, rows, text, columns).map((row, i) => (
        <Text key={`row-${i}`} wrap="truncate-end">
          {row}
        </Text>
      )),
    )
  })

  on('command.run', { command: 'claudinho' }, async ($, e) => {
    // The command answers by itself (never `next`): one run on the band's PATH, the band's reading of the answer. No
    // `--columns` (the CLI's own 200-column ceiling, never the window's), none of the band's state touched. The text
    // typed after it is read for one word alone: `match` opens the pane; anything else is ignored. Neither call
    // rejects out of here: `runEnv` never rejects, and the spawn's rejection is a failed run.
    const env = await runEnv($)
    const lang = await runLang($)
    let result: RunResult | undefined
    try {
      result = await $.process.run(['claudinho', 'ambient', '--json', ...langArgs(lang)], {
        timeoutMs: RUN_TIMEOUT_MS,
        stdin: '',
        ...(env ? { env } : {}),
      })
    } catch {
      // No binary, a timeout, a refused spawn: no answer.
    }
    const reading = readAnswer(result)
    // A view stating its `lang` marks the CLI as localizing before any match run (headless too: no band run there).
    markLocalizes(reading)
    if (typeof e.args === 'string' && e.args.trim() === PANE_WORD) {
      // The pane: the match of this same reading, read and opened inside the hook. A pane that opened with the CLI's
      // rows, on a surface that draws it now, carries the attribution and the disclaimer: the reply is the line and a
      // short note. Otherwise (headless, nothing to bind, a first read that failed) the bare reply.
      let opened = false
      try {
        opened = await openPane($, reading, env)
      } catch {
        // The engine's calls failed: no pane this time; the reply stands.
      }
      if (opened && reading.answered && reading.isView && (await mayRun($))) {
        return { text: `${viewReply(reading.view, reading)}${PANE_OPEN_NOTE}` }
      }
    }
    return { text: replyTo(reading) }
  })

  on('ui.close', { id: PANE_ID }, async ($, e, next) => {
    // The pane closed: its re-reads stop and its generation moves on, so a read in flight from before writes nothing.
    try {
      await closePane($)
    } catch {
      // A state write failed: the binding and the timers are already gone.
    }
    return next(e)
  })

  on('ui.render', { component: 'Pane', requestId: PANE_ID }, async ($, e, next) => {
    // The pane draws its value alone: the CLI's rows, each wrapped (never cut sideways), laid out at the pane's own
    // width when the engine gives one (`bodyColumns`, a positive integer) and the value carries the rows' roles
    // (`paneLayout`: a narrow dock splits the named event rows and indents the continuation of a long row), else
    // verbatim; then a blank row and the footer dimmed; or one fixed sentence. Its size is the engine's (the body
    // scrolls); no Button.
    const v = await read($, pane)
    if (v === null) return next(e)
    const { Box, Text } = $.ui.resolve(e)
    const width = e.props.bodyColumns
    const rows: PaneDrawnRow[] = []
    if (v.refreshFailed) rows.push({ text: PANE_REFRESH_FAILED })
    if (v.kind === 'failed') rows.push({ text: PANE_FAILED })
    else if (v.kind === 'noView') rows.push({ text: PANE_NO_VIEW })
    else {
      // The CLI's styled rows when it printed them (CLI 0.12.0), else its `lines` as before.
      if (Array.isArray(v.rows)) {
        if (typeof width === 'number' && Number.isInteger(width) && width > 0 && Array.isArray(v.roles)) {
          rows.push(...paneLayout(v.rows, v.roles, width))
        } else {
          for (const parts of v.rows) rows.push(parts.length === 0 ? { text: ' ' } : { text: '', parts })
        }
      } else {
        for (const line of v.lines) rows.push({ text: line === '' ? ' ' : line })
      }
      const footer = [v.attribution, v.disclaimer].filter((s): s is string => typeof s === 'string')
      if (footer.length > 0) {
        rows.push({ text: ' ' })
        for (const s of footer) rows.push({ text: s, dim: true })
      }
    }
    const drawn = (row: PaneDrawnRow, key: string) =>
      row.parts ? (
        <Text key={key} wrap="wrap">
          {row.parts.map((p, j) => (
            <Text key={`part-${j}`} {...partStyle(p.style)}>
              {p.text}
            </Text>
          ))}
        </Text>
      ) : row.dim ? (
        <Text key={key} dimColor wrap="wrap">
          {row.text}
        </Text>
      ) : (
        <Text key={key} wrap="wrap">
          {row.text}
        </Text>
      )
    return (
      <Box flexDirection="column">
        {rows.map((row, i) =>
          row.indent ? (
            <Box key={`row-${i}`} paddingLeft={row.indent}>
              {drawn(row, 'text')}
            </Box>
          ) : (
            drawn(row, `row-${i}`)
          ),
        )}
      </Box>
    )
  })

  on('prompt.submit', async ($, e, next) => {
    // The last current view's context, while that view is inside its own deadline and its run is recent. Never a
    // subprocess here: the timer's last run is the only source. Under `context: off`, nothing beside the prompt.
    if (!contextOn) return next(e)
    const record = await read($, lastContext)
    if (record?.context) {
      const now = await $.clock.now()
      const deadline = record.staleAfter === null ? Number.NaN : Date.parse(record.staleAfter)
      if (Number.isFinite(deadline) && now < deadline && now - record.ranAt < CONTEXT_MAX_AGE_MS) {
        return next({ ...e, context: [...(e.context ?? []), record.context] })
      }
    }
    return next(e)
  })
}

/**
 * The contract of the claudinho plugin: what it keeps in the session (`$.state`), each value under
 * `PluginState.claudinho`. Everything is read from `claudinho ambient --json`, the installed CLI's view of its
 * local cache, and the match pane's rows from `claudinho match <id> --json`; the plugin never fetches (the CLI does). A view is readable when it carries its `live` list and says what its line
 * is, `idle` and `empty` as two booleans (`@claudinho/cli` 0.11.2 or later); anything else (the first-run object, the
 * fallback object, a view from an older CLI) is no view: hidden, never current, the baseline kept.
 */

/**
 * The band's line as the CLI fitted it, or null when there is nothing to show, the last run failed, or a run found no
 * surface that draws the band (none attached, or the roster could not be read). `parts`: the CLI's `lineParts` (at most
 * 64, each a text and, for a score token the fit kept whole, the style `strong`), kept only when their texts joined
 * equal `text` exactly; the band then draws each `strong` part bold. Absent (an older CLI, or parts that do not join to
 * the line): the plain line.
 */
export type ClaudinhoBand = { text: string; parts?: Array<{ text: string; style?: 'strong' }> } | null

/**
 * The band's pace: when the last run started (the clock's milliseconds) and whether the CLI said its answer was idle
 * (the first-run object, nothing chosen; or a view whose `idle` is true, the edition over), which is read once per
 * five minutes instead of every fire. `ranAt` is read only while `idle` is true; `{ ranAt: 0, idle: false }` is what a
 * clear leaves (a run that found no surface that draws the band, or the last such surface detached).
 */
export type ClaudinhoPace = { ranAt: number; idle: boolean }

/**
 * The identity of a live record's `lastGoal` (CLI 0.12.0): the goal's kind, its minute and added time, the side it
 * counted for, and the player when named. Two `lastGoal` objects are the same goal when every field is equal; a
 * `lastGoal` the previous current view already carried is not the goal that made a new score.
 */
export type ClaudinhoGoal = {
  type: 'GOAL' | 'OWN_GOAL' | 'PEN'
  minute: number
  added?: number
  side: 'home' | 'away'
  player?: string
}

/**
 * One live match as the toasts remember it: its id, its two tallies, and (a record that carries `names`, CLI 0.12.0)
 * its `lastGoal` identity when it had one. A record without `names` (CLI 0.11.2) keeps no `lastGoal`: its toast is
 * the CLI's record's own `line`, and the plugin reads neither field for it.
 */
export type ClaudinhoTally = {
  id: string
  score?: { home: number; away: number }
  shootout?: { home: number; away: number }
  lastGoal?: ClaudinhoGoal
}

/**
 * The toasts' baseline: the last CURRENT view's live matches, under its competition. Replaced by every current view,
 * kept through a view that is not current and through a failed run (a change across the gap is said at the next
 * current view); null before the first current view.
 */
export type ClaudinhoBaseline = { slug: string; items: ClaudinhoTally[] } | null

/**
 * The prompt context's record: the last CURRENT view's context block (null when it had none), its own display
 * deadline (`staleAfter`, ISO 8601, or null) and when its run started. Cleared by a view that is not current, kept
 * through a failed run.
 */
export type ClaudinhoContext = { context: string | null; staleAfter: string | null; ranAt: number } | null

/**
 * One play of the goal celebration, by its kind, each with its own length on screen:
 * - `banner` (3 s): a view whose record carries no `names` (CLI 0.11.2), today's frames: a ball crossing a row, an
 *   English "GOAL" banner growing, then `text`, the goal's toast line (`⚽` and the CLI's record line);
 * - `goal` (3 s): a goal toast for the pinned side (with no `pinnedSide`, any goal toast): the mascot, the ball crossing
 *   the top row, `word` (the view's goal word the toast was built with: `GOAL!`, `¡GOL!`; whole on every frame) and
 *   `team` on the middle row, `detail` on the bottom row (the scorer and the goal's minute, the own-goal detail and the
 *   minute, or the record's clock minute alone, as built); `minute` is the one-row form's minute;
 * - `fulltime` (5 s): full time for the pinned side on a win or a draw: the mascot beside `<heading> · <result>`, the
 *   words it was built with (`Full time`, and `<team> win` or `Draw`, filled); `outcome` is the result as evidence (the
 *   winning side and team, each `null` for a draw: `ClaudinhoOutcome`), the one thing a later view is compared with.
 */
export type ClaudinhoPlay =
  | { kind: 'banner'; text: string }
  | { kind: 'goal'; word: string; team: string; minute: string; detail: string }
  | { kind: 'fulltime'; outcome: ClaudinhoOutcome; heading: string; result: string }

/**
 * A full-time play's evidence: the winning side (`null` for a draw) and the winning team's identity as the finished
 * record states it, its `id` when it carries one, else its `code` and `name` (each `null` when the record states
 * none); `null` for a draw. A later current view keeps the play only with the same side and the same identity.
 */
export type ClaudinhoOutcome = {
  winner: 'home' | 'away' | null
  team: { id: string } | { code: string | null; name: string | null } | null
}

/**
 * The goal celebration's record: its first play (its `kind` and that kind's fields) and `queue`, the plays after it
 * (at most one: full time's, behind a goal decided in the same read, its own 5 s), played one after the other as one
 * stretch; when the run that saw it decided it (the clock's milliseconds), the competition of the view it was decided
 * in (its `competition.slug`, `''` when it states none), the match's id, and that match's regulation and shootout
 * tallies in the view it was decided on (each when present: its own evidence; a finished record's at full time). Both
 * plays are under one hold while Claude works and one 60-second drop counted from `at`. Its four writers, in a run's
 * order: any answer naming another competition, or none, current or not (a view, or the first-run object; the fallback
 * object names none and leaves it), nulls it; its match's score changing in any later current view (by `id`, in the
 * live list or the finished list, whatever the `toasts` filter: a tally both carry differing from the record's, a
 * correction or a later goal the plugin did not see as one; an absent match or tally is no news) nulls it, both
 * plays with it; a full-time play is kept only while each later current view lists its match in `finished` with the
 * same result (its `outcome`, never its words): a current view listing it live again, listing it nowhere, or giving
 * another result (or none)
 * drops that play (the record when the play is its own, its `queue` when it follows a goal, the goal play then kept
 * under the rules above); the run's last match with a play writes it (a run a clear superseded writes nothing; never under `celebrate:
 * off`); and the band's clear nulls it. The draw's guard: a record another module load wrote (its `at` not this
 * load's) is never played; it stays in state until a goal or a clear replaces it. A played or expired record also
 * stays until the next one replaces it (the draw ignores it). The draw reads it; its frames are not state.
 */
export type ClaudinhoCelebration =
  | (ClaudinhoPlay & {
      at: number
      slug: string
      id: string
      score?: { home: number; away: number }
      shootout?: { home: number; away: number }
      queue?: ClaudinhoPlay[]
    })
  | null

/** One part of a pane row: its text and its style (`strong` bold, `dim` dimmed, `accent` and `flair` the theme's
 * `success` colour, `quote` dimmed italic; none: plain). */
export type ClaudinhoPanePart = { text: string; style?: 'strong' | 'dim' | 'accent' | 'quote' | 'flair' }
/** One pane row: its parts, in order. */
export type ClaudinhoPaneRow = ClaudinhoPanePart[]

/**
 * The match pane's generation: a number that only grows, never null, which a new binding takes its own value from
 * (a reload starts the module's values over; this number does not). Its two writers: `/claudinho match` binding a
 * match (+1) and the `ui.close` hook for the pane `match` (+1). What fences an answer from before a close or a reopen
 * is the module's binding and the pane value's own `gen`, both checked inside the write.
 */
export type ClaudinhoPaneGen = number

/**
 * The match pane's value (`/claudinho match`), read by the pane's draw alone: the generation it was written under, the
 * competition (`slug`) and match `id` it is bound to, what the last `claudinho match <id> --json` read said (`rows`:
 * one JSON value whose `lines` is an array of strings; `noView`: one JSON value without such `lines`; `failed`: no
 * answer), the CLI's `lines` (at most 150, each cut at 600 characters), its styled `rows` when it printed them (CLI
 * 0.12.0: each row the parts of the line at its index, kept only when every row's parts join to that line; at most 150
 * rows of at most 64 parts, each row cut at 600 characters; a style the plugin does not draw is a plain part), beside
 * them each row's `roles` (the one fact of the CLI's `rows[i].role` the drawing uses: `'event'` when that role is
 * exactly `'event'`, else null; written with `rows` alone, as long as `rows`, so a value from a plugin load before
 * them has none and the pane draws it as before) and its `attribution` and `disclaimer` (each a
 * non-empty string cut at 1,000 characters, else absent), whether the last re-read failed (the rows kept from the read
 * before it), and the fields the re-reads decide by: the answered match's `status` and `kickoff` (null with no match),
 * and whether that status is final (`FT`, `POSTPONED`, `CANCELLED`). Its writers: the open, twice under its new
 * generation (first a provisional value before its read, `rows` holding the view's line and its footer, with no status
 * or kickoff; then its read's answer, while its binding is still the module's), a re-read only while its generation is
 * the binding's (a failed one keeps the rows and sets `refreshFailed`), and the
 * `ui.close` hook, which nulls it. Null before the first open and after a close.
 */
export type ClaudinhoPane = {
  gen: number
  slug: string
  id: string
  kind: 'rows' | 'noView' | 'failed'
  lines: string[]
  rows?: ClaudinhoPaneRow[]
  roles?: Array<'event' | null>
  attribution?: string
  disclaimer?: string
  refreshFailed: boolean
  status: string | null
  kickoff: string | null
  final: boolean
} | null

declare module 'claude-code' {
  interface PluginState {
    claudinho: {
      band: ClaudinhoBand
      pace: ClaudinhoPace
      baseline: ClaudinhoBaseline
      context: ClaudinhoContext
      celebration: ClaudinhoCelebration
      paneGen: ClaudinhoPaneGen
      pane: ClaudinhoPane
    }
  }
}
